hook.name: LaunchFeeProtectionHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that applies graduated anti-snipe buy fees based on elapsed time since launch (up to 99% at block 0, tapering to 0% after a few seconds), collects fees from both buy and sell swaps, and distributes them to the token creator, protocol recipient, and an optional buyback vault. Swaps are gated by launch stage set by the platform factory.
